goal: A Requests batch-read failure is regression-tested so its alert cannot make a write-scoped claim.
non_goals: Add a shared assertion before a second read-failure consumer exists.
user_visible_behavior: A failed Requests batch read still offers retry and never tells the owner that nothing was sent or nothing changed.
invariants: Assertions are scoped to the load-failure alert.
edge_cases: A 500 followed by a successful retry renders the recovered state.
Legitimate settled-state copy elsewhere is unaffected.
existing_patterns_to_follow: The same test file separately pins unconfirmed write outcomes without conflating the two invariants.
test_seams: The rendered role=alert after GET batch returns 500, followed by the existing retry flow.
tests_to_add: offers a retry after a failed load without claiming nothing was sent or changed
